attributes.action: Bring back the death penalty for murder, rape and serious harm of children
attributes.background: Where evidence is concrete, bring back the death penalty when children are murdered, raped or seriously harmed by an adult.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Referendum to reinstate death penalty for most serious crimes against children
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775259
